Pair.description: maxItems not past them closes the tuple.

UpToTwo.description: Items past minItems up to maxItems are optional: a tuple for each length.

Few.description: maxItems alone too: the equal items one rest, bounded by length, where that is shorter.

Some.description: Equal optional items that end it are one rest, bounded by length, where that is shorter than a tuple for each length.

Hundred.description: The length is that of a tuple where that is shorter than listing each.

Ten.description: The lengths are listed only where the whole list is no longer than the tuple.

NonEmptyHundred.description: The tuple of the lengths has the required items, then the optional ones.

Rows.description: A tuple bounded by length is parenthesized as array items.

Groups.description: One that is not needs no parentheses.

PaymentMethods.description: Two equal items are repeated where that is shorter than writing both.

ShortNonEmpty.description: A tuple bounded by length needs no parentheses in an intersection.

Objects.description: An object type is written once.

Empty.description: maxItems 0 admits only the empty array.

Head.description: With prefixItems, maxItems not past them closes the tuple.

Short.description: maxItems inside prefixItems leaves out the rest of them.

HeadUpTo.description: maxItems past prefixItems adds optional items of the items schema.

LongHead.description: prefixItems are repeated where they are equal.

Long.description: minItems past prefixItems requires items of the items schema.

ClosedLonger.description: maxItems past prefixItems with items false adds no item.

ClosedShorter.description: maxItems inside them leaves out the rest of them.

Unreachable.description: minItems past prefixItems with items false admits nothing.

AtLeastTwo.description: minItems without type is an array.

Split.description: allOf members meet item by item.

SplitMax.description: maxItems in another member closes the tuple.

SplitClosed.description: minItems past a closed tuple in another member admits nothing.

Alike.description: Members written alike are written once, in parentheses where they bind looser than their place.

AlikeAlone.description: Alone, the member left needs no parentheses.

Languages.description: Where a tuple for each length is just longer than the rest bounded by length, the rest is written.

Lines.description: A tuple whose items are all the rest's is an array, which needs no parentheses as array items.

TupleOrArray.description: Nor does a member written alike that is not an intersection.

IntegerOrNumber.description: Intersections written alike leave one, in parentheses as array items.

AlikeInIntersection.description: In an intersection, the member left needs no parentheses.

NotArray.description: Array keywords constrain only arrays, so the strings type names pass them.
